description: This file implements a server-side component for handling remote procedure calls and object proxying related to 'blivet' utilities, including network communication, object serialization, and method invocation.

classes.name: BlivetProxyObject
classes.description: Represents unpicklable objects for proxying over network.

classes.name: BlivetUtilsServer
classes.description: Handles network requests, object proxying, and method invocation for 'blivet' utilities.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main request handling loop for incoming network messages.

methods.name: _recv_msg
methods.description: Receives a message from the client, first reading message length.

methods.name: _recv_data
methods.description: Receives specified amount of data from the client.

methods.name: _pickle_answer
methods.description: Serializes answer objects, creating proxies if necessary.

methods.name: _get_param
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value from a proxy object.

methods.name: _get_next
methods.description: Gets the next item from an iterable proxy object.

methods.name: _get_key
methods.description: Retrieves a key from a proxy object.

methods.name: _blivet_utils_init
methods.description: Initializes a BlivetUtils instance on the server.

methods.name: _call_method
methods.description: Invokes a method on a proxy object.

methods.name: _call_utils_method
methods.description: Calls a method from the BlivetUtils instance.

methods.name: _progress_report_hook
methods.description: Sends progress updates during long operations.

methods.name: _args_convertTo_objects
methods.description: Converts arguments from proxies to actual objects.

methods.name: _kwargs_convertTo_objects
methods.description: Converts keyword arguments from proxies to actual objects.

methods.name: _send
methods.description: Sends data back to the client, prefixed with length.
